title: Body of newborn baby found on Welsh shoreline, prompting search for mother
summary_full: Police and medics fear mother could be ‘extremely vulnerable’, after discovery in Bangor close to Menai strait on SundayPolice are searching for the mother of a newborn baby whose body was found on a Welsh shoreline, fearing she may be ill or vulnerable.A member of the public found the body of the child, whose age and sex have not been disclosed, close to the Menai strait in north Wales.
